episodes.title: China-ASEAN expo to highlight FTA 3.0 opportunities
episodes.description: Event organizer say the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo will spotlight new business opportunities under the China-ASEAN Free Trade Area 3.0 framework, with more than 3,400 companies from over 70 countries and regions set to participate.
episodes.transcript:
Now the news. I'm Kalu.

Organizers say this year's China-ASEAN Expo will spotlight new business opportunities under the Free Trade Area 3.0 framework. More than 3,400 companies from over 70 countries and regions are set to participate in the expo in Nanning from Thursday to next Monday. The expo will feature products and projects in areas ranging from traditional industries to digital communications, green development and artificial intelligence. Timor-Leste will participate for the first time as a full ASEAN member and a co-host of the expo, bringing all 11 ASEAN member states together in Nanning following the bloc's expansion. China has remained ASEAN's largest trading partner for 17 consecutive years, while ASEAN has been China's largest trading partner for six successive years.

China and Brazil have reaffirmed their commitment to deepening strategic cooperation and injecting stability into a turbulent world. It comes as senior Chinese diplomat Wang Yi met with Celso Amorim, special advisor to the president of Brazil, in Beijing. Wang also welcomed Brazil's decision to join the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization and said China stands ready to jointly advance AI for good and inclusive, human-centered development. He called on the two countries to strengthen strategic coordination on major international and regional issues, uphold multilateralism and advance the Global South's collective empowerment. Amorim expressed Brazil's willingness to advance pragmatic cooperation and build a closer Brazil-China community with a shared future.

China's defense minister says the Chinese military is ready to work with armed forces around the world to put the Global Security Initiative into practice and strengthen cooperation in emerging areas of security governance. In his address at the opening ceremony of the Beijing Xiangshan Forum, Dong Jun also called for countries to uphold multilateralism, resolve disputes through dialogue and strengthen cooperation through common development. He urged vigilance against all forms of hegemonism, militarism and historical revisionism.

U.S. President Donald Trump has threatened to cut trade ties with the EU after European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed making Canada its first associate member. In her annual State of the Union address to the European Parliament, von der Leyen said the EU and Canada would seek to upgrade their ties from the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement to an Alliance for the Future. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney attended the address in Strasbourg.

The U.S. Federal Reserve has raised interest rates for the first time in more than three years in a renewed fight against inflation. Officials voted to raise their benchmark lending rate by a quarter point to a range of 3.75 to 4 percent. All of the Fed's policymakers were on board with Wednesday's decision. The committee said that, as inflation remains elevated, the policy action was appropriate to ensure a timely return to the 2 percent goal. Tony Waterman has more.

Warsh, leaning into the strength of the economy, pointed to the resilient job market, the very strong retail sales that we've been seeing, and also the surge in capital investment. Of course, the major outlier for the U.S. economy has been this stubbornly high inflation. It was 3.7 percent in August, and the expectation is that this will continue to climb, given the inflationary pressures from the war in Iran, but also the AI build-out, which is driving up tech costs across the country.

U.N. humanitarians say funding shortfalls and Israeli restrictions on the import of critical items are slowing down the response to a deadly Gaza building collapse. The U.N. Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs and its partners visited the site of the collapsed building on Wednesday to mobilize a rapid response to support survivors. Civil defense teams had retrieved 21 bodies and rescued dozens of people with injuries. Dozens more had been helped out of the area overnight, shortly before the collapse, when the building started cracking. Local health authorities said 12 children were among those killed.

Indonesian rescuers plan to try to right a passenger ship that capsized in the Java Sea last weekend. Persistent strong currents and big waves have prevented them from making an underwater search of the overturned vessel for the 129 people still missing.

And that's the news. I'm Taylor.
episodes.translationZh:
现在播报新闻，我是卡卢。

主办方表示，本届中国—东盟博览会将重点展示中国—东盟自由贸易区 3.0 版框架下的新商机。来自 70 多个国家和地区的 3400 多家企业将参加本届博览会，展会于周四在南宁开幕，持续至下周一。展品和项目涵盖传统产业、数字通信、绿色发展和人工智能等领域。东帝汶将首次以东盟正式成员和博览会共同主办方的身份参会。随着东盟扩员，全部 11 个成员国将齐聚南宁。中国已连续 17 年保持东盟最大贸易伙伴地位，东盟也连续 6 年成为中国最大贸易伙伴。

中国和巴西重申将深化战略合作，为动荡的世界注入稳定力量。中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京会见了巴西总统特别顾问塞尔索·阿莫林。王毅还对巴西决定加入世界人工智能合作组织表示欢迎，并表示中方愿同巴方携手推动人工智能向善发展，促进包容、以人为本的发展。他呼吁两国就重大国际和地区问题加强战略协调，维护多边主义，推动全球南方实现集体赋能。阿莫林表示，巴方愿推进务实合作，构建更加紧密的巴中命运共同体。

中国国防部长表示，中国军队愿与世界各国军队一道，推动落实全球安全倡议，加强新兴安全治理领域合作。董军在北京香山论坛开幕式上致辞时还呼吁各国坚持多边主义，通过对话解决争端，通过共同发展加强合作。他强调，要警惕各种形式的霸权主义、军国主义和历史修正主义。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普威胁切断与欧盟的贸易关系。此前，欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩提议让加拿大成为欧盟首个准成员。冯德莱恩在法国斯特拉斯堡向欧洲议会发表年度盟情咨文时表示，欧盟和加拿大将寻求把双方关系从《全面经济与贸易协定》升级为“面向未来联盟”。加拿大总理马克·卡尼出席了这场讲话。

美国联邦储备委员会在新一轮抗击通胀行动中加息，这是三年多来首次加息。官员们投票决定将基准利率上调 25 个基点，至 3.75% 至 4% 的区间。美联储所有决策者都支持周三的决定。委员会表示，鉴于通胀仍处高位，此次政策行动有助于使通胀及时回到 2% 的目标。托尼·沃特曼带来更多报道。

沃什强调美国经济的强劲表现，并提到就业市场保持韧性、零售销售十分强劲，以及资本投资激增。当然，美国经济最大的例外仍是居高不下的顽固通胀。8 月通胀率为 3.7%，预计还将继续上升，原因既包括伊朗战争带来的通胀压力，也包括人工智能基础设施建设推高了全美的科技成本。

联合国人道主义机构表示，资金短缺以及以色列对关键物资进口的限制，正在拖慢对加沙一栋建筑倒塌事故的救援响应。联合国人道主义事务协调厅及其合作伙伴周三前往倒塌现场，动员快速响应力量支援幸存者。民防队伍已找到 21 具遇难者遗体，并救出数十名伤者。大楼开始开裂后、倒塌前不久，又有数十人在夜间被疏散出该区域。当地卫生部门表示，遇难者中有 12 名儿童。

印度尼西亚救援人员计划尝试扶正上周末在爪哇海倾覆的一艘客船。持续的强海流和大浪使他们无法潜入水下搜寻倾覆船只中仍然失踪的 129 人。

以上是本次新闻，我是泰勒。

episodes.title: Green hydrogen stands out as highlight of China-Namibia cooperation
episodes.description: China-Namibia cooperation in the green energy sector is flourishing, with green hydrogen standing out as the highlight of their partnership. Leveraging their advantages in renewable energy equipment manufacturing and technologies, Chinese companies are playing an important role across Namibia's green hydrogen value chain.
episodes.transcript:
China-Namibia cooperation in the green energy sector is flourishing, with green hydrogen standing out as the highlight of their partnership. Namibia boasts rich solar and wind energy resources, providing exceptional natural conditions for developing its green hydrogen industry. Leveraging their advantages in renewable energy equipment manufacturing and technologies, Chinese companies are playing an important role across Namibia's green hydrogen value chain. Green hydrogen represents a transformative opportunity for Namibia to diversify its economy, reduce reliance on fossil fuel imports, and position itself as Africa's green hydrogen hub. For more, Zhou Fang spoke with Jona Musheko, manager for external affairs and communications at the Namibia Green Hydrogen Program.

Zhou Fang: Could you tell us something about China-Namibia cooperation in green hydrogen? What role are Chinese companies playing in this area?

Jona Musheko: If you look at the element of resources in terms of equipment, some of the equipment required and some of what we've used is sourced from Asia. And China is one of those countries that has the potential to supply needed equipment within this sector. There is an opportunity to continue with this trade relationship within this particular sector. For instance, the supply of solar panels, the supply of energy storage solutions, and other technologies, electrolyzers and so on. These are opportunities for China to continue to work with Namibia. The relationship is strong. China has the potential to supply equipment in some areas.

Zhou Fang: When I was reading articles related to this cooperation, I came across a company called Hyphen in your country, and I read something about Chinese participation. Anything about this? Could you introduce some signature projects?

Jona Musheko: With Hyphen, none of the partners are from China there. But those are really the partnerships that exist as opportunities within this sector. There is a project that has involvement from a company like Envision. Envision is from China. You have got a number of other players from China that have got an interest, not just in the green hydrogen sector. And that comes within the framework of, for instance, the public-private partnership initiative. And so far, one of those is driven by our power industry, our power production entity, which is NamPower. They have done, and are busy doing, some projects which, in a sense, have the footprint of Chinese suppliers, and those sources are coming from China. So it is not just within the limited scope of green hydrogen. It is in the value chain, or subsector, of renewable energy, which really presents an opportunity not just for Chinese players, but for all other players from other parts of the world.
episodes.translationZh:
中国与纳米比亚在绿色能源领域的合作蓬勃发展，其中绿氢是双方合作的一大亮点。纳米比亚拥有丰富的太阳能和风能资源，为发展绿氢产业提供了得天独厚的自然条件。中国企业凭借在可再生能源设备制造和技术方面的优势，正在纳米比亚绿氢价值链的各个环节发挥重要作用。绿氢为纳米比亚带来了转型机遇，可帮助该国推动经济多元化、减少对进口化石燃料的依赖，并确立其作为非洲“绿氢枢纽”的地位。就此，周芳采访了纳米比亚绿氢计划对外事务与传播经理乔纳·穆谢科。

周芳：您能否介绍一下中国与纳米比亚在绿氢领域的合作？中国企业在这一领域发挥着怎样的作用？

乔纳·穆谢科：从设备资源来看，我们所需以及已经使用的一些设备来自亚洲。中国正是具备为这一行业供应所需设备潜力的国家之一。双方有机会在这个具体领域延续贸易关系，例如供应太阳能电池板、储能解决方案，以及电解槽等其他技术。这些机会将推动中国继续与纳米比亚合作。两国关系稳固，中国也有能力在一些领域供应设备。

周芳：我在阅读有关双方合作的文章时，注意到贵国有一家名为 Hyphen 的公司，也看到了一些关于中国参与的信息。您能否谈谈这方面的情况，并介绍一些标志性项目？

乔纳·穆谢科：Hyphen 的合作方中目前没有来自中国的企业，但这一领域确实存在建立这类伙伴关系的机会。有一个项目获得了远景科技集团等企业的参与，远景是一家中国公司。此外，还有许多其他中国企业对此感兴趣，而且兴趣并不局限于绿氢领域。这些合作也可在公私合营倡议等框架下开展。目前，其中一些项目由我国电力行业的发电实体 NamPower 推动。NamPower 已经开展、并正在推进一些项目，这些项目在一定程度上带有中国供应商的印记，相关资源也来自中国。因此，合作并不局限于绿氢，而是延伸至可再生能源的价值链或细分领域。这不仅为中国企业，也为世界其他地区的企业带来了切实机会。

episodes.title: Innovation and entrepreneurship emerge as core driving force in China-Egypt cooperation
episodes.description: Innovation and entrepreneurship have emerged as core driving forces in higher education cooperation between China and Egypt. In recent years, bilateral collaboration has evolved from traditional academic exchanges to deeper synergy centered on technology transfer, industrial incubation, and entrepreneurship.
episodes.transcript:
Narrator: Innovation and entrepreneurship have emerged as core driving forces in higher education cooperation between China and Egypt. In recent years, bilateral collaboration has evolved from traditional academic exchanges to deeper synergy centered on technology transfer, industrial incubation, and entrepreneurship. The cooperation model has transitioned to a two-way approach featuring joint laboratories and collaborative efforts to tackle key technological challenges. Through innovation and entrepreneurship, technology transfer and research outcomes are more closely linked with industrial applications. A complete value chain has taken shape in talent cultivation, comprising intergovernmental joint committees, university programs, and enterprise participation. For more, Zhou Fang spoke with Dr. Mohamed Mamdouh Abdelkhalek from Mansoura University in Egypt.

Zhou Fang: Doctor, what were the most important impressions and lessons you gained from this trip?

Dr. Mohamed Mamdouh Abdelkhalek: It gave me the opportunity to see China's development model on the ground. There, we could see how development planning, financial institutions, smart customs, education, infrastructure, and investment are connected within one economic ecosystem. After the visit, we were able to coordinate further engagement with China, including a visit connected with the China-BRICS Science and Innovation Incubation Park for the New Era. It's a great incubation environment.

Zhou Fang: How do you see the role of universities in strengthening China-Egypt cooperation in higher education, especially in light of the growing strategic relationship between the two countries?

Dr. Mohamed Mamdouh Abdelkhalek: We invited the China-BRICS incubator from China to attend a conference in Egypt. We had a great conference, with more than 500 participants. Our students from the Delta region at our university and other universities participated in a social competition organized by this incubation institution.

Zhou Fang: Looking to the future, what initiatives or areas of cooperation would you like to see developed between Egyptian universities and Chinese universities, other institutions, and their industry partners?

Dr. Mohamed Mamdouh Abdelkhalek: I would like to see more cooperation and joint innovation programs, startup incubation, technology commercialization, and industrial research. China is especially distinguished by its startups. What I deeply respect about the Chinese people is their long civilization, like Egypt's, and their strong philosophy of work, partnership, and shared benefit. China's approach to cooperation is based on building opportunities together, creating value together, and sharing the results of development. This is exactly the kind of partnership we hope to experience as a developing country like Egypt with Chinese universities, innovation institutions, and industrial partners—a partnership based on mutual respect, mutual benefit, and long-term cooperation. We have already started to build bridges with many universities in China and to create initiatives related to young entrepreneurs and startups, perhaps in more advanced fields like health tech and agri-tech.
episodes.translationZh:
旁白：创新和创业已成为中埃高等教育合作的核心驱动力。近年来，双方合作已从传统的学术交流，发展为以技术转移、产业孵化和创业为重点的更深层协同。合作模式也转向双向合作，包括共建联合实验室、携手攻克关键技术难题。借助创新创业，技术转移和科研成果与产业应用结合得更加紧密。在人才培养方面，一条由政府间联合委员会、高校项目和企业参与共同组成的完整价值链已经形成。为了进一步了解情况，周芳采访了埃及曼苏拉大学的 Mohamed Mamdouh Abdelkhalek 博士。

周芳：博士，这次访问给您留下的最重要印象是什么？您从中获得了哪些启示？

Mohamed Mamdouh Abdelkhalek 博士：这次访问让我有机会实地了解中国的发展模式。在那里，我们看到发展规划、金融机构、智慧海关、教育、基础设施和投资如何在同一个经济生态系统中相互衔接。访问结束后，我们得以进一步协调与中方的交流，其中包括与“新时代中国—金砖国家科技创新孵化园”开展访问交流。那里的孵化环境非常出色。

周芳：当前中埃战略关系日益深化，您认为大学应如何进一步推动两国高等教育合作？

Mohamed Mamdouh Abdelkhalek 博士：我们邀请了来自中国的金砖国家孵化机构参加在埃及举行的一场会议。那次会议办得非常成功，有 500 多人参加。我们大学以及其他高校中来自尼罗河三角洲地区的学生参加了由该孵化机构组织的一项社会创新竞赛。

周芳：展望未来，您希望埃及高校与中国高校、相关机构及产业合作伙伴在哪些项目或领域进一步开展合作？

Mohamed Mamdouh Abdelkhalek 博士：我希望双方开展更多合作，包括联合创新项目、初创企业孵化、技术商业化和产业研究。中国在培育初创企业方面尤其突出。我非常敬佩中国人民的一点，是中国和埃及一样拥有悠久文明，同时形成了重视实干、伙伴关系和成果共享的理念。中国的合作方式以共同创造机会、共同创造价值、共享发展成果为基础。对于埃及这样的发展中国家来说，我们正希望与中国高校、创新机构和产业伙伴建立这样的合作关系——一种以相互尊重、互利和长期合作为基础的伙伴关系。我们已经开始与中国多所高校搭建桥梁，并着手推动面向青年创业者和初创企业的项目，未来还可能拓展到医疗科技、农业科技等更先进的领域。

episodes.title: Unearthed memory: Latin America’s largest slave graveyard found beneath Salvador car park
episodes.description: An archaeological discovery beneath a Salvador city-center car park has uncovered a forgotten chapter of Brazil’s role as a major gateway of the transatlantic slave trade, where hundreds of thousands of enslaved Africans once arrived.
episodes.transcript:
Brazil's northeastern city of Salvador was once a major gateway for the transatlantic slave trade, where hundreds of thousands of enslaved Africans arrived. Now, an archaeological discovery beneath a city-center car park is bringing a long-buried chapter of that history back to light. Archaeologists believe they have found the largest burial ground for enslaved people in Latin America—a site that disappeared from official maps nearly two centuries ago.

What looks like an ordinary car park in central Salvador was once one of the city's earliest public cemeteries, known as the Cemitério Polverim, or Gunpowder Ground. Eighteenth-century maps show the cemetery clearly. For about 150 years, until 1844, it was used to bury some of the city's most marginalized people, predominantly enslaved Africans. Then, the cemetery disappeared from official records.

Archaeologist Jeanne Dias says the site was deliberately buried under more than two meters of soil. "In other local cemeteries, you find human remains at a depth of about a meter and a half. But here, the burial layer starts below 2.9 meters. Above that, we dug through layers of broken bricks, nails, and household rubbish. Once that cleared, we hit the original soil—and then fragments of bone began to appear. First a few, then in vast numbers."

The discovery followed an investigation launched in 2024 by urban planner Silvana Olivieri and her legal team. By overlaying eighteenth-century maps onto modern satellite images, Olivieri was able to pinpoint the cemetery's location. She then petitioned Brazil's National Institute of Historic and Artistic Heritage to protect the site.

"This was a place of extreme violence and terror. Bodies were piled up for days until there were enough to dig a pit and dump them in, stacked on top of one another—without a single ritual or funeral. And that disrespect continued right up to the modern era, when they built a car park over their graves."

A ten-day excavation in May 2025 confirmed human remains beneath the asphalt. Just one kilometer away is a square where enslaved Africans were once publicly whipped to death. Now, campaigners are calling for a permanent memorial.

Federal University of Bahia law professor Samuel Vida says the site belongs to everyone. "This is human heritage. More than a hundred thousand enslaved people were laid to rest here. It stands as evidence of one of the gravest crimes against humanity in history. Our goal is to build a permanent site for reflection—perhaps a memorial and a museum—so that the city, the state, and Brazilian society as a whole can finally reconnect with their history of slavery."

Brazil's heritage authority has now officially designated the site an archaeological area, known as the Cemitério dos Africanos, or Cemetery of Africans. The car park has been permanently closed.
episodes.translationZh:
巴西东北部城市萨尔瓦多曾是跨大西洋奴隶贸易的重要门户，数十万被奴役的非洲人从这里抵达。如今，市中心一处停车场下的考古发现，让一段被深埋已久的历史重新浮出水面。考古学家认为，他们发现了拉丁美洲规模最大的奴隶墓地。这处遗址近两个世纪前便从官方地图上消失了。

萨尔瓦多市中心这片看似普通的停车场，曾是这座城市最早的公共墓地之一，名为 Cemitério Polverim，意为“火药墓地”。18 世纪的地图清楚标出了这座墓地。大约 150 年间，直到 1844 年，这里一直用于埋葬城中最受排斥的人群，其中绝大多数是被奴役的非洲人。此后，这座墓地从官方记录中消失。

考古学家 Jeanne Dias 表示，这处遗址被人刻意掩埋在两米多厚的土层之下。她说：“在当地其他墓地，通常在约一米半深处就能发现人类遗骸。但这里的墓葬层要到地下 2.9 米以下才开始出现。上面的土层中满是碎砖、铁钉和生活垃圾。清理完这些之后，我们触及了原始土层，随后骨骼碎片开始显现——起初只有少量，接着数量越来越多。”

这一发现源于城市规划师 Silvana Olivieri 及其法律团队在 2024 年发起的一项调查。Olivieri 将 18 世纪地图叠加到现代卫星图像上，从而确定了墓地的位置。随后，她向巴西国家历史与艺术遗产研究所提出申请，要求保护该遗址。

她说：“这里曾是一个充斥着极端暴力和恐怖的地方。遗体会堆放数日，直到数量足够多，才挖一个坑，把他们层层叠叠地扔进去，没有任何仪式，也没有葬礼。这种不尊重一直延续到现代，人们甚至在他们的坟墓上修建了停车场。”

2025 年 5 月进行的十天发掘证实，沥青层下确实有人类遗骸。仅一公里外，还有一处广场，被奴役的非洲人曾在那里遭到公开鞭打并被处死。如今，活动人士呼吁在此修建永久纪念设施。

巴伊亚联邦大学法学教授 Samuel Vida 表示，这处遗址属于所有人。他说：“这是全人类的遗产。十万多名被奴役的人长眠于此。这里见证了人类历史上最严重的反人类罪行之一。我们的目标是建立一处永久的反思空间，也许是一座纪念馆和博物馆，让这座城市、这个州乃至整个巴西社会最终能够重新面对本国的奴隶制历史。”

巴西遗产主管部门现已正式将这里认定为考古遗址，并命名为 Cemitério dos Africanos，即“非洲人墓地”。停车场已永久关闭。

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East: a new frame on anti-war films
episodes.description: What makes Once Upon a Time in the Middle East stand out from traditional war films? Zhang Junnan, the film’s English subtitle translator, shares how its story of food, humanity and hope brings a fresh perspective to the genre.
episodes.transcript:
The Chinese film Once Upon a Time in the Middle East has hit cinemas nationwide, offering a fresh take on the traditional war-film narrative. Set in a Chinese restaurant in war-torn Iraq, the film follows a chef who uses food to bring comfort and a sense of safety to local civilians amid the chaos. The film has grossed more than 1.3 billion yuan, or about 180 million US dollars, in its first 10 days. For more, Song Ruixin spoke with Zhang Junnan, the film's English subtitle translator.

Song Ruixin: Now that Once Upon a Time in the Middle East has announced overseas release plans, your subtitles, of course, will effectively become the first conversation with those international audiences. So, from your point of view, when you make a Chinese film more accessible to international audiences, where is the line between helping them understand Chinese culture and changing the film to make it more accessible?

Zhang Junnan: Well, what we're doing in translation is trying to reduce the language barrier. There are two types of audience for the English subtitles themselves. People who know nothing about Chinese can only rely on the English subtitles to comprehend the lines. And people who are bilingual, people who know Chinese and English at the same time, may check or may not check the subtitles. My real purpose, my real audience, is the former: people who don't know anything about it. The thing I pay a lot of attention to is enabling them to understand very quickly what a line is about, because they also have to pay attention to the pictures, not just the words. So I wouldn't change the meaning much unless I had to.

Song Ruixin: I recently read a report in which the director of the movie said that three meals a day represent people's longing for a peaceful life and are simply a call from ordinary people. I've also seen some Hollywood war films—not all of them, but most of them are built around heroes, battlefields and even victory. What does this different way of telling a war story reveal about the Chinese perspective and its wish for peace?

Zhang Junnan: We are the kind of people who have this grassroots perspective all the time. We always talk about the people—the people, everything for the people. So I think one reason our civilization has such a long-lasting history is that we value the survival of our families, our people, and the whole nation. We also value this long heritage across generations. It's something that's built into our genes. This grassroots perspective, especially when it's combined with something like food, is what I call the most common factor for all people. It's about that most common factor, and these are things we can start with when we talk about and tell stories.
episodes.translationZh:
中国影片《Once Upon a Time in the Middle East》已在全国院线上映，为传统战争片的叙事带来了新的视角。影片以战火中的伊拉克一家中餐馆为背景，讲述一名厨师如何用食物为当地平民带来慰藉与安全感。上映前十天，影片票房已超过13亿元人民币，约合1.8亿美元。CGTN记者 Song Ruixin 就此采访了该片英文字幕翻译 Zhang Junnan。

Song Ruixin：如今，《Once Upon a Time in the Middle East》已经公布海外发行计划，您的字幕自然会成为这部影片与海外观众展开的第一次对话。依您看，当您努力让一部中国电影更容易被海外观众理解时，帮助他们理解中国文化与为了便于接受而改变影片之间，界线在哪里？

Zhang Junnan：翻译所做的，就是尽量降低语言障碍。英文字幕的观众大致有两类：一类完全不懂中文，只能依靠英文字幕理解台词；另一类是中英双语观众，他们可能会看字幕，也可能不会。我的真正目标受众是前一类，也就是对中文完全不了解的人。我会格外注意让他们迅速明白一句台词在说什么，因为他们还得看画面，不能只盯着文字。因此，除非确有必要，我不会大幅改变原意。

Song Ruixin：我最近看到一篇报道，影片导演说，一日三餐代表着人们对和平生活的向往，也体现了普通人的朴素呼声。我也看过一些好莱坞战争片——并非全部，但其中多数围绕英雄、战场，甚至胜利来展开。这种不同的战争叙事方式，体现了怎样的中国视角和对和平的愿望？

Zhang Junnan：我们一直是从普通人的基层视角出发的。我们总在谈人民——人民，一切为了人民。我认为，我们的文明之所以拥有如此悠久、绵延不绝的历史，一个原因就是我们重视家庭、人民乃至整个民族的生存，也珍视代代相传的悠久传承。这种观念仿佛已融入我们的基因。这种基层视角，尤其与食物这样的事物结合时，就会成为我所说的全人类最普遍的共同点。我们讲述故事、展开交流，都可以从这些最普遍的共同点出发。

episodes.title: SAR government releases third five-year plan for economic and social development
episodes.description: The Macao Special Administrative Region has unveiled its third five-year plan for 2026 to 2030, charting the next phase of the region's economic and social development.
episodes.transcript:
The Macao Special Administrative Region has unveiled its third five-year plan for 2026 to 2030, charting the next phase of the region's economic and social development. The document sets out 35 major economic and social development indicators and defines eight development goals. They include fully implementing national security guidelines, further improving governance under the rule of law, and making substantial progress in economic diversification. Other goals cover the integrated development of education, science, technology and talent, steadily improving residents' well-being, and making important progress in building a beautiful and smart Macao.

Wong Sio Chak is the Secretary for Administration and Justice of the Macao SAR government. He says enhancing the effectiveness of law-based governance is critical to delivering the goals and tasks of the Third Five-Year Plan.

Wong Sio Chak: Public administration reform is a key pillar of the Third Five-Year Plan. It is a primary and essential initiative for enhancing government effectiveness and advancing good governance. An efficient, streamlined and coordinated public administration system is the cornerstone of effective government. The Macao SAR government will strengthen macro-level coordination, improve its organizational structure, streamline administrative procedures and remove bottlenecks, so as to build a clean, efficient and proactive modern service-oriented government.

Wong adds that alignment on institutional innovation is vital for the integrated development of Hengqin and Macao. He says such alignment is a key lever for future growth, but also the hardest challenge to overcome.

Wong Sio Chak: The Macao SAR government will spare no effort in advancing the high-quality development of the Cooperation Zone in its second phase, strengthen alignment with existing plans and policy documents, and focus on key areas such as people's livelihoods and industries. It will foster a high-quality rule-of-law environment and promote the alignment of rules in market access, factor mobility, standards, accreditation and certification, and industry regulation, thereby supporting the integrated development of Macao and Hengqin.

episodes.title: China unveils measures to boost county-level consumption
episodes.description: China has unveiled a set of measures to further stimulate consumption in lower-tier markets and invigorate county-level consumer spending. The plan includes upgrading township commercial centers, rural markets, and local fairs.
episodes.transcript:
China has unveiled a set of measures to further stimulate consumption in lower-tier markets and invigorate county-level consumer spending. A new guideline from the Commerce Ministry and eight other government departments aims to boost spending in county areas. The plan includes upgrading township commercial centers, rural markets and local fairs. It also encourages domestic and international brands to open regional debut stores and calls for redeveloping existing land resources.

The guideline allows eligible chain businesses and individual merchants to run multiple outlets within the same county under a single license, in an effort to promote new business models. It also calls for better services for the elderly and children, more efficient urban-rural distribution networks, stronger county-level employment, and more ways for residents to boost their incomes. The measures come as China seeks to give consumption a bigger role in driving economic growth. Lower-tier markets, generally referring to third-tier and smaller cities, counties, townships and rural areas, account for about 70 percent of China's population.

For more, Zhou Fang spoke with Zhou Mi, a senior research fellow at the Chinese Academy of International Trade and Economic Cooperation.

Zhou Fang: Could you first give us an overview of this, and what's the significance of releasing a guideline specifically targeting county-level consumption?

Zhou Mi: In the past several years, we have fulfilled our commitments to improving people's well-being and trying to reduce extreme poverty. In the next several years, I think it's time for us to revitalize the villages. The market is also trying to provide better and stronger support for the integration of the domestic market, which is very important for us to achieve sustainable development and realize our target of Chinese-style modernization.

Zhou Fang: Talking about county-level consumption, official data shows that in the first five months of this year, county and township markets accounted for over 39 percent of total retail sales of consumer goods. How do you view these figures, and what impact do you think this will have on China's overall consumption growth?

Zhou Mi: Well, it provides us with more opportunities to develop unified growth in consumption, whether in major cities or in villages. It is a really big issue for us to deal with the differences in China: the gaps between urban and rural areas, and also between the eastern regions and the central and western regions. So we need better integration of our domestic market. That requires us to do more to address the weak links and improve the overall performance of development.

In this regard, I would say that many people are living in villages, and even more consumption is coming from villages and rural areas. If we're trying to achieve better modernization, we need to look at that. Because they do not yet enjoy the same quality as cities, villages and rural areas are developing much more quickly. I think that is a good phenomenon: these areas are catching up with the leading urban regions. I think this is the kind of thing we are going to support—not just providing them with more products, but also improving the quality of consumer products and services.

First, we want to encourage leading companies, companies that are well known in the cities, and even companies from other countries, to invest more in rural areas. They can use their influence, high-quality management systems and supply chains to provide better support for the consumption choices of people living in rural areas.

episodes.title: Technologies open new avenues for China-Africa media cooperation
episodes.description: African media professionals are calling for deeper and more practical cooperation with their Chinese counterparts, as digital platforms and artificial intelligence reshape how stories are produced and shared.
episodes.transcript:
African media professionals are calling for deeper and more practical cooperation with their Chinese counterparts as digital platforms and artificial intelligence reshape how stories are produced and shared.

At the 7th China-Africa Media Cooperation Forum in Beijing, African journalists said closer exchanges could help both sides better understand each other, as new technologies are creating fresh opportunities for African newsrooms.

Nigerian journalist Michael Onjewu believes media cooperation starts with something fundamental: helping audiences understand what is actually happening between China and Africa.

Michael Onjewu: The role of media is strategic in the sense that without proper media, there are negative stereotypes about countries. But with proper media cooperation, we can begin to tell the true stories about the China-Africa relationship.

Technology is adding another dimension to that cooperation. Zimbabwean political commentator Derek Goto says AI is already making media production faster and less costly, while affordable Chinese AI models are making that technology increasingly accessible to African newsrooms.

Derek Goto: For Africa, DeepSeek, for example—you want to do your research, it's free, so any newsroom can use it. You want to do scripting. So that accessibility in terms of pricing, I think, is a real game changer, not just for Africa, but for the world at large.

Ugandan journalist Raziah Athman adds that greater use of AI also raises questions about credibility, governance and the future role of journalists.

Raziah Athman: AI cannot take the human touch out of journalism or media. I don't see a time when AI will ever do that. So AI is here to stay. It's about remaining as human as possible, remaining relevant to our audiences.

As part of the forum program, journalists also visited Rednote, a popular Chinese social media platform, where they saw firsthand how social media is allowing Chinese and African voices to reach audiences directly. Athman says such platforms can open new channels not only for communication, but also for business and people-to-people exchanges.

Raziah Athman: With the discovery and formulation of new platforms like Rednote, I think the most important thing, especially for young people who hold the biggest market, is that social media will help with direct access and relationships. And it works both ways—not just for a Chinese person being able to access the market in Uganda, but all of Africa. So many Africans are also looking for ways of getting into the Chinese market.

The tools for telling China-Africa stories are evolving. And as those tools become more accessible, the opportunity is growing for Chinese and African media to tell those stories more directly and in their own voices.
episodes.translationZh:
随着数字平台和人工智能重塑新闻内容的生产与传播方式，非洲媒体从业者呼吁与中国同行开展更深入、更务实的合作。

在北京举行的第七届中非媒体合作论坛上，非洲记者表示，加强交流有助于双方更好地了解彼此，而新技术也正为非洲新闻编辑部带来新的机遇。

尼日利亚记者 Michael Onjewu 认为，媒体合作应从一项最基本的工作开始：帮助受众了解中非之间真实发生的事情。

Michael Onjewu：媒体具有战略作用。如果缺少恰当的媒体报道，人们就会对其他国家形成负面刻板印象。但通过良好的媒体合作，我们可以开始讲述真实的中非关系故事。

技术正在为这种合作增添新的维度。津巴布韦政治评论员 Derek Goto 表示，人工智能已经让媒体制作变得更快、成本更低，而价格亲民的中国人工智能模型正使这项技术越来越容易被非洲新闻编辑部采用。

Derek Goto：以非洲使用 DeepSeek 为例，你想做研究，它是免费的，所以任何新闻编辑部都可以使用；你也可以用它来写脚本。就价格和可及性而言，我认为这确实改变了游戏规则，不仅对非洲如此，对全世界也是如此。

乌干达记者 Raziah Athman 补充说，人工智能得到更广泛的应用，也带来了有关可信度、治理以及记者未来角色的问题。

Raziah Athman：人工智能无法取代新闻或媒体工作中的人情味。我看不到人工智能有一天能够做到这一点。因此，人工智能会长期存在，关键是尽可能保持人的温度，并继续与我们的受众保持紧密联系。

作为论坛活动的一部分，记者们还参访了中国热门社交媒体平台小红书（Rednote），亲眼看到社交媒体如何让中国和非洲的声音直接触达受众。Athman 表示，这类平台不仅能够开辟新的沟通渠道，也能为商业往来和民间交流打开新的通道。

Raziah Athman：随着小红书这类新平台的出现和发展，我认为最重要的一点，尤其是对构成最大市场的年轻人来说，是社交媒体能够帮助人们建立直接联系和关系。这种作用是双向的：不仅中国人可以进入乌干达乃至整个非洲市场，许多非洲人也在寻找进入中国市场的途径。

讲述中非故事的工具正在不断演进。随着这些工具变得更易获得，中国和非洲媒体也拥有越来越多机会，以更直接的方式、用自己的声音讲述这些故事。
